description: Find apps similar in meaning to one app, using embedding similarity over their listings (limited to the given storefront). Each result has rating, rating count, revenue and downloads estimates and a distance (lower means closer). Results are sorted by downloads estimate, biggest first, not by distance. Use it to build a competitor list; use search_apps to look up an app by name instead.

app_id.description: App Store ID of the reference app

limit.description: Maximum number of similar apps (1-50, default: 12)

name: get_similar_apps
title: Get similar apps
